name: Copenhagen
summary: Copenhagen is one of the most livable cities in the world: Scandinavian design, extremely high security, first-class gastronomy and an enviable cycling infrastructure. Being part of the EU, Spanish nomads can settle without visa procedures. Of course, it is one of the most expensive capitals in Europe, something that compensates with a quality of life that is difficult to match.
